question: On 15 February 2021, which of the following authors was honoured with the Sanctuary Lifetime Service Award 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Theodore Baskaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Writer, historian, naturalist, and activist, S Theodore Baskaran__ has won the 2020 Sanctuary Reserve Lifetime Service Award.
 
• The award was instituted by the Sanctuary Nature Foundation.
 
• Theodore was chosen for the award for his dedication to wildlife conservation and his writing prowess in English and Tamil that contribute to the conservation discourse.
 
• For his nature writings in Tamil, Theodore was awarded a Lifetime Achievement Award (Iyal Virudhu) by the Canada Literary Garden in 2014 in Toronto.

 [IMAGE: https://www.sanctuarynaturefoundation.org/uploads/Award/1612023942858_Lifetime_Service_Award_-_S.Theodore_Baskaran_350.png]
